# goldens/shim/pal-surface.txt -- the shim gate's expectation for the P/Invoke-facing
# native surface of the .NET runtime pack at the pin: every exported name of the five
# class-library native libraries by family, with the class the shim answers it in
# (defined: before this survey; served: by a hand-written answer; refused: a generated
# refusal). GENERATED by tools/extract-pal/gen_pal_surface.py from the pack's export
# tables; regenerate at a re-pin, never edit by hand. The case shim.pal-surface
# asserts the shim's defined family names equal this set and that this pin is the
# SDK's; the rederive leg's survey control re-reads the archives named here.
